doc: Test fixture: per-instance tint and lift (instanced params, read in surface() and vertex(), also in the shadow pass) and a per-draw boost.

tint.doc: Emission color; its alpha scales the strength. One value per entity.

raise.doc: World-space lift of every vertex in meters. One value per entity.

boost.doc: Multiplies the tint. One value per draw: entities with different values draw separately.
